title: The Black Devils in Plaquemine and Charlie Love
summary: Vincent says the Black Devils tried to hire him; he met Charlie Love in Shreveport when selling music with Clarence Williams, and Love was from Plaquemine.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
